summary.text:
# 重整队伍 / Regroup

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany

## 如何开始 How it starts

战争开始时（on_war_beginning，00_on_actions.txt:2604），若有舰队在开战瞬间失联（war_begun_num_fleets_gone_mia > 0）则弹出，解释舰队失踪或虫洞站被毁的原因。

When a war begins (on_war_beginning, 00_on_actions.txt:2604), if any fleets went missing at the start (war_begun_num_fleets_gone_mia > 0) it explains why ships are missing or wormhole stations destroyed.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口，正文按失踪舰队为一支或多支而变；唯一选项OK。

A single window whose text depends on one or several missing fleets; the only option is OK.
